artifacts.enantiomorph:
101010
既济 水火既济 坎上离下
既济：亨；老狐已济，收其尾，有攸利。
译文：《既济卦》象征事已完成：亨通已得圆满；老狐狸渡河已到对岸了，收拢了尾巴，则有所吉利。
象曰：水在火上，既济；君子以安处物归方。
译文：《象辞》说：《既济卦》的卦象是离（火）下坎（水）上，为水在火上之表象。水在火上，沸水温润，火力承载，水火相承相济，象征着已完成；君子此时安处各种事物，见事物之本质，稳然使事物已归于定，这样做则万事已成。
artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
101010
Already Fulfilled, Water over Fire, Kan above Li below
Already Fulfilled: Passage granted; the old fox has already crossed, gathering in its tail — there is benefit.
Gloss: The hexagram of Already Fulfilled symbolizes the completion of affairs: passage has reached its fullness; the old fox, crossing the river, has reached the far bank, drawing its tail close — thus there is advantage.
The Image says: Water above fire — Already Fulfilled; the noble one thereby rests settled among things, returning each to its place.
Gloss: The Image commentary says: The image of the Already Fulfilled hexagram is Li (fire) below and Kan (water) above, forming the figure of water resting upon fire. Water upon fire, the heated water warms gently, the fire's force sustains it, water and fire mutually uphold and complete each other, symbolizing completion; the noble one at such a time rests settled among all things, perceiving the essence of things, holding steady so that all affairs have returned to their settled state — acting thus, all endeavors are already accomplished.

independent.recovered_law: TEXT A depicts the state of 'not yet completed' (未济) where things are in process and potentially unfavorable (小狐/濡尾/无攸利/水火相克/努力使变化趋好), while TEXT B inverts every relation to depict 'already completed' (既济) where things are finished and favorable (老狐/收尾/有攸利/水火相济/安处已归于定). The hexagram binary, trigram positions, elemental relationships, agent maturity, and outcome direction are all systematically reversed.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: from an incomplete/not-yet-crossed state (未济) to a completed/already-crossed state (既济), with the recovered claim detailing the systematic reversal of all relational elements (agent, outcome, elemental interaction) that constitutes this crossing completion.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B consistently maintains the inverted 'completed/settled' relation (已完成, 已归于定, 万事已成) without reverting to TEXT A's 'not yet completed' framing.
